key.name: profile
key.description: off, work, games or sleep: the profile picked by hand from the Focus tile, ame desktop focus or Control. While it is not off it wins over the triggers.

key.name: ends
key.summary: When the profile picked by hand ends
key.description: Seconds since the epoch; 0 keeps it on until it is turned off.

key.name: off-at
key.summary: When Off was last picked by hand
key.description: Seconds since the epoch. A trigger that is on at that moment waits for its next start.

key.name: trigger-games
key.summary: Games while a game is in front
key.description: Games turns on when a game gets the keyboard and ends when that game closes.

key.name: trigger-sleep
key.description: Sleep turns on at Night Light's evening time and ends at its morning time, whether or not Night Light itself is on.

key.name: work-banners
key.description: shown: as GNOME shows them; apps: only the apps in the list (and calls, alarms and urgent ones); held: none but calls, alarms and urgent ones. Held banners wait in the list.

key.name: work-apps
key.description: Launcher IDs (APP.desktop) whose banners come through while banners is apps.

key.name: work-sounds
key.description: Off: notifications make no sound, but calls, alarms and urgent ones.

key.name: work-dock
key.description: as-set: as the dock's own setting says; touch: it hides while a window touches it. The dock's setting is not written.

key.name: work-lighter
key.summary: Work: solid glass and shorter motion
key.description: The glass solid and animations at half their time, as power saver makes them.

key.name: work-night-light
key.description: as-set: as you set it; paused: paused until the profile ends; warmest: on, at its warmest (written, and put back when the profile ends).

key.name: work-power
key.description: as-set, performance or power-saver, held with the power daemon while the profile is on.

key.name: work-accent
key.description: theme, or one of the twelve accents, laid over the theme's while the profile is on.

key.name: work-wallpaper
key.description: as-set, or night: the theme's Daylight night picture over your wallpaper while the profile is on.

key.name: work-grey
key.description: The whole screen without colour while the profile is on. One more full-screen pass for every frame.

key.name: work-set
key.description: The name of a saved set offered when the profile is picked by hand, after asking; empty for none.
